dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.allGood: No project in trouble, overdue or gone quiet.

title: Projects
intro: The portfolio of the workspace: every project, subject or workstream, its health and the people working on it. Meetings follow the projects they talk about.
empty: No project yet. Describe the projects of the team, then follow them in a meeting to give each one its turn.
name: Name
summaryHint: What the project is, as people should remember it.
leadLocked: Only the people managing every project hand it over.
members: {count, plural, =0 {People working on it} one {# person working on it} other {# people working on it}}
descriptionHint: Goals, scope, what success looks like.
themesHint: Themes group the projects of the portfolio: a programme, a product line, a department. Deleting a theme keeps its projects.
themeDeleteConfirm: Delete the theme {name}? Its projects stay, without a theme.
deleteConfirm: Delete the project {name}? Its sheets are deleted; the items and actions about it stay, without a project.
noTimeline: Nothing yet: once a meeting that follows the project archives a session, what was said about it shows here.

followed.title: Projects followed
followed.intro: Each project followed gets a tab in everyone's check-in and, with a project round in the agenda, a turn of its own where its people speak together.
followed.noRound: The agenda has no project round yet: the items about these projects are presented in each person's turn. Add the “Project round” block in Agenda to give each project its turn.
followed.none: The meeting follows no project yet.
followed.allFollowed: Every project of the portfolio is already followed.
followed.noneHint: Pick the projects this team talks about: each one gets its tab in the check-in and its turn in the meeting.
followed.whoAddsHint: Projects always come from the workspace portfolio. Reordering them and removing one stay with the hosts.

by.hostsHint: Only the people who configure the meeting choose its projects.
by.participantsHint: Anyone taking part can bring a project from their check-in.

programmeHint: The project it belongs to: a project holding others is a programme.
visibilityMembers: Its members only (and the people managing every project)
membersEdit: Its members can edit it, not only its lead
imported: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing new was imported.} one {# project imported.} other {# projects imported.}}
importedFailed: {count, plural, one {# could not be imported.} other {# could not be imported.}}
importedHidden: {count, plural, one {# of them is hidden by the current filters.} other {# of them are hidden by the current filters.}}
importFromTools: Import from GitHub, GitLab, Jira or Linear

source.title: From {tool}
source.issues: {done} of {total, plural, one {# ticket} other {# tickets}} closed
source.refused: The last update failed: {tool} refused the issue tracker’s token. An administrator can check it in the workspace settings.
source.notFound: The last update failed: {tool} can no longer find the repository or project it came from.
source.failed: The last update failed: {tool} did not answer. Ronde tries again within the hour.
source.gone: {tool} no longer finds it: it was deleted or moved, or the issue tracker’s token can no longer read it. Ronde tries again once a day.
source.once: Imported on {date}, not kept in sync: edit it in Ronde.
source.unlinkConfirm: Stop syncing {name} with {tool}? It stays as it is and is edited in Ronde only. Sync cannot be turned back on for this project.
source.editHint: Its name, status and dates come from {tool}: changes you make to them here are replaced at the next update, within the hour.
source.editHintRepo: Its name comes from {tool}: a new name given here is replaced at the next update, within the hour.
source.rateLimited: The last update was put off: {tool} asked Ronde to slow down. It tries again within the hour.
source.paused: Kept in sync with {tool} until the Team plan ended. It resumes with the plan.
source.trackerRemoved: No longer kept in sync: its issue tracker was removed from the workspace settings.
source.moved: No longer kept in sync: its issue tracker now points to another server.
source.unlinked: Imported on {date}, no longer kept in sync: edit it in Ronde.
source.archived: Not updated while it is archived: restore it to keep it in sync with {tool}.

logo.notSaved: The logo could not be saved.
logo.unreadable: This image cannot be read. Use a PNG, JPEG or WebP file.
